description: Use when the user asks to purchase, subscribe, provision, open, or place an order for any Volcengine commercial product, or uses Chinese verbs such as "开通 / 购买 / 下单 / 买 / 售卖 / 想买 / 订购" together with a Volcengine product name. Trigger even when the user does not mention "sale" but expresses a clear provisioning intent.
